days_meaning: each delivery day costs you this much cash

messages.text: Fair opening: 50 primas with 10 delivery days, which suits you.
Rápido y justo: 70 P, día 10. ¿Qué día de entrega te va mejor? / Quick and fair: 70 P, day 10. Which delivery day suits you best?
52 P with delivery in 10 days works for me and we can close now.
Parece que el día te importa: 63 P con día 10. / It seems the day matters to you: 63 P, day 10.
Meeting you closer: 54 P with delivery in 10 days.
